# `persuasion` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "persuasion" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/persuasion/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `"persuasion"` | required | Always "persuasion": there is one table. |
| `notes` | string | required | Where the numbers come from (bead, tuning status). |
| `base` | integer -50–50 | required | Score every check starts from. |
| `bandModifiers` | object | required | Score change per NPC disposition band (hostile, cold, neutral, friendly, devoted). |
| `bandModifiers.hostile` | integer -50–50 | required | Added when the NPC's disposition band is hostile. |
| `bandModifiers.cold` | integer -50–50 | required | Added when the NPC's disposition band is cold. |
| `bandModifiers.neutral` | integer -50–50 | required | Added when the NPC's disposition band is neutral. |
| `bandModifiers.friendly` | integer -50–50 | required | Added when the NPC's disposition band is friendly. |
| `bandModifiers.devoted` | integer -50–50 | required | Added when the NPC's disposition band is devoted. |
| `labels` | object | required | Difficulty labels the UI shows, by margin. |
| `labels.easyFrom` | integer | required | Margin (score minus difficulty) from which a check is easy. |
| `labels.fairFrom` | integer | required | Margin from which a check is fair. |
| `labels.hardFrom` | integer | required | Margin from which a check is hard; below it, impossible. |
| `modifiers` | list of object | `[]` | Class, capability, item or fact modifiers that apply to every check. |
| `modifiers[].approaches` | list of `"persuade"` \| `"intimidate"` \| `"deceive"` \| `"charm"` (at least 1) | — | The approaches it applies to. Omit: every approach. |
| `modifiers[].when` | object | required | A logic DSL condition: an object with a `kind` and that kind’s fields. |
| `modifiers[].when.kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "playerClass". |
| `modifiers[].bonus` | integer -50–50 | required |  |
| `modifiers[].label` | string | required | Why, in the words shown to the player. |
| `personality` | list of object | `[]` | Modifiers from the NPC’s personality, matched on its creature definition. |
| `personality[].approaches` | list of `"persuade"` \| `"intimidate"` \| `"deceive"` \| `"charm"` (at least 1) | — | The approaches it applies to. Omit: every approach. |
| `personality[].trait` | `"bravery"` \| `"curiosity"` \| `"aggression"` \| `"diligence"` \| `"sociability"` \| `"greed"` | required | A creature personality trait (0–1). |
| `personality[].atLeast` | number 0–1 | — | Applies at or above this. |
| `personality[].atMost` | number 0–1 | — | Applies at or below this. |
| `personality[].bonus` | integer -50–50 | required |  |
| `personality[].label` | string | required | Why, in the words shown to the player. |
